title: The Bluest Eye

vibeProfile.oneLine: A Black girl prays for blue eyes in a world that calls her ugly.

summary: In 1940s Ohio, a young Black girl named Pecola Breedlove prays for blue eyes, believing that whiteness would make her lovable in a world that treats her as ugly and worthless. Toni Morrison's devastating first novel traces how a whole community's absorbed self-hatred and a family's abuse destroy a child, writing beauty, racism and cruelty with unflinching lyric power. Hard to read and impossible to forget, it announced one of the great voices of American literature.
whyReadIt: Morrison's devastating debut about a child crushed by absorbed self-hatred. Hard to read, impossible to forget.

funFacts.text: It was Morrison's first novel; she went on to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1993.
